notes.title: Small Game Fix Update
notes.content:
A new internal version of the game is now available that fixes a few smaller bugs, the main one being players sometimes having issues saving the game. This should now be fixed! It will not affect current save games, but should work with future ones. Note that this issue was related to Steam not always saving the fact that a game had already been installed previously, not anything to do with the game's actual code.

A few small adjustments in income from various activities and a small bug that rarely made income not calculated with the various street properties correctly are included too.

Thanks and enjoy!
Derek - Lead Dev/Programmer, SimProse Studios

notes.title: Game Released!
notes.content:
Gangster Empire: Vendetta has been released!

The game should be fairly bug free at this point, but if you have any issues, feel free to let us know on the forums. One thing: A few systems may require a restart before playing so it looks right, since the game installs a few fonts, but most systems should be good to go. If you have big system font settings on Windows 7, it may look a little odd too.

If you have any questions about the game, we'll always be glad to answer on our forums.

Thanks for reading and enjoy!
Derek - Lead Developer/Designer, SimProse Studios
